Explore Events Join Us About Our Group We are Google Developer Group on Campus at the University of Jeddah, a student technology community that brings together people passionate about technology, innovation, and learning in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and the exchange of knowledge and experience. Through workshops, tech events, and hands-on projects, we empower our members to develop technical and leadership skills, explore new fields, and turn ideas into practical projects and solutions—helping build a generation of technologists ready to innovate and make an impact. +165 Members +10 Events +9 Projects 10 Committees What We Offer 1 Learn & Empower Workshops and events that build your skills and expand your knowledge. 2 3 4 Meet the Group Leaders Leaders united by a passion for technology and innovation, working together to bring our vision to life and create lasting impact. Abdullah Misar Google Developer Group Lead Jumanah Alshaibi Google Developer Group Co-Lead Made by Our Members Explore our members’ projects, from innovative ideas to real achievements that turn knowledge into impact. 01 GDG UJ Interactive Gaming Platform Web Design and Development Committee A customizable multiplayer gaming platform for GDG events. 02 BracketClick AI Committee An AI-powered photobooth triggered by hand gestures. 03 GDG Air Hockey AI Committee A touchless air hockey game controlled by hand movements. 04 GDG Prompt Pilot AI Committee A shared AI prompt library for GDG committees. 07 Integrated Data Management and Visualization System Data Analysis Committee A centralized database and live dashboards for GDG data. 08 Internal Phishing Simulation Cybersecurity Committee A controlled phishing campaign to assess security awareness. 09 Website Security Assessment & Hardening Cybersecurity Committee A security audit and hardening project for the GDG web platform. 01/09 Latest updates & Announcements View all announcements Stay tuned… UPCOMING EVENTS Discover What’s Next Join our events, build your skills, grow your network, and explore new opportunities with Google Developer Group on Campus at the University of Jeddah. Stay informed… Our Success Partners Our sponsors support our vision and empower our journey of learning, innovation, and impact.
